metadata.question: Is the chlorophyll-a concentration higher in the southern coastal waters of Java (-8.879787, 110.2273416) compared to the northern Java Sea waters (-5.741852, 109.953683) on August 4, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS-Aqua L3SMI daily chlorophyll-a (NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI) on 2019-08-04. If empty, try GCOM-C SGLI CHLA (JAXA/GCOM-C/L3/OCEAN/CHLA/V3) for the same day; if still empty, widen the window to ±1 day, then to 8 days.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (ocean L3 products are preprocessed). Mask non-positive and extreme values (<=0 or >1000 mg/m³). Use 10 km buffer around each point.
3. Logic for valid zero vs null: Check collection size; if zero after all fallbacks => C1. If after masking, pixel counts at either site are zero => C2. If mean is null/NaN => C3. Otherwise compare means and output A (South > North) or B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const southPt = ee.Geometry.Point([110.2273416, -8.879787]).buffer(10000);
    const northPt = ee.Geometry.Point([109.953683, -5.741852]).buffer(10000);
    const day = ee.Date('2019-08-04');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Fallback Strategy
    const attempts = [
      { id: 'NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI', start: day, end: day.advance(1, 'day'), label: 'MODIS Daily (exact day)', scale: 4000 },
      { id: 'JAXA/GCOM-C/L3/OCEAN/CHLA/V3', start: day, end: day.advance(1, 'day'), label: 'GCOM-C Daily (exact day)', scale: 1000 },
      { id: 'NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI', start: day.advance(-1, 'day'), end: day.advance(2, 'day'), label: 'MODIS Daily (±1 day)', scale: 4000 },
      { id: 'JAXA/GCOM-C/L3/OCEAN/CHLA/V3', start: day.advance(-1, 'day'), end: day.advance(2, 'day'), label: 'GCOM-C Daily (±1 day)', scale: 1000 },
      { id: 'NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI', start: day.advance(-3, 'day'), end: day.advance(5, 'day'), label: 'MODIS Daily (8-day window)', scale: 4000 },
      { id: 'JAXA/GCOM-C/L3/OCEAN/CHLA/V3', start: day.advance(-3, 'day'), end: day.advance(5, 'day'), label: 'GCOM-C Daily (8-day window)', scale: 1000 },
    ];

    // Initial quick report of exact-day MODIS availability
    const modisExactCount = await ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI')
      .filterDate(day, day.advance(1, 'day')).size().getInfo();
    console.log(`MODIS Daily images (2019-08-04): ${modisExactCount}`);

    let chosen = null;
    let chosenCol = null;
    for (const att of attempts) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(att.id).filterDate(att.start, att.end);
      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size > 0) {
        chosen = { ...att, size };
        chosenCol = col;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log('No images found after fallbacks.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Using: ${chosen.label}, Images: ${chosen.size}, Window: ${await chosen.start.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}→${await chosen.end.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}`);

    // 3. Processing: Harmonize band to 'chla' and mask invalids
    function toChla(img) {
      if (chosen.id.indexOf('MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') >= 0) {
        return img.select(['chlor_a']).rename(['chla']);
      } else if (chosen.id.indexOf('GCOM-C/L3/OCEAN/CHLA') >= 0) {
        return img.select(['CHLA']).rename(['chla']);
      } else {
        return ee.Image(null);
      }
    }
    let chlaImg = chosenCol.map(toChla).median();
    // Mask non-physical values
    chlaImg = chlaImg.updateMask(chlaImg.gt(0)).updateMask(chlaImg.lt(1000));

    // 4. Pixel count to detect C2 and compute means
    const reducers = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true });
    const southDict = chlaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers,
      geometry: southPt,
      scale: chosen.scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    });
    const northDict = chlaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers,
      geometry: northPt,
      scale: chosen.scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    });

    const southMean = await southDict.get('chla_mean').getInfo();
    const southCount = await southDict.get('chla_count').getInfo();
    const northMean = await northDict.get('chla_mean').getInfo();
    const northCount = await northDict.get('chla_count').getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const sCount = southCount || 0;
    const nCount = northCount || 0;
    console.log(`South (Java south coast): pixels=${sCount}, mean_chla=${southMean !== null ? southMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`);
    console.log(`North (Java Sea): pixels=${nCount}, mean_chla=${northMean !== null ? northMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`);

    if (sCount === 0 || nCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (southMean === null || northMean === null || !isFinite(southMean) || !isFinite(northMean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Compare: Is south > north?
    const answer = southMean > northMean ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
